passages.text: Then the LORD said to Moses, “Tell the Israelites to bring Me an offering. You are to receive My offering from every man whose heart compels him.
passages.sermon:
The LORD spoke to Moses.
The LORD gave Moses a command.
The LORD told Moses to speak to the Israelites.
The LORD told Moses to ask the Israelites for an offering.
The LORD said to take an offering from every man.
The LORD said to accept the offering from any man whose heart moves him to give.
The LORD called this offering "My offering."
passages.original: וַיְדַבֵּ֥ר יְהוָ֖ה אֶל־ מֹשֶׁ֥ה לֵּאמֹֽר׃ דַּבֵּר֙ אֶל־ בְּנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל וְיִקְחוּ־ לִ֖י תְּרוּמָ֑ה מֵאֵ֤ת כָּל־ אִישׁ֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר יִדְּבֶ֣נּוּ לִבּ֔וֹ תִּקְח֖וּ אֶת־ תְּרוּמָתִֽי׃

passages.text: This is the offering you are to accept from them: gold, silver, and bronze; blue, purple, and scarlet yarn; fine linen and goat hair; ram skins dyed red and fine leather; acacia wood; olive oil for the light; spices for the anointing oil and for the fragrant incense; and onyx stones and gemstones to be mounted on the ephod and breastpiece.
passages.sermon:
God spoke to Moses on Mount Sinai.
God told Moses to receive offerings from the Israelites.
God listed the offerings Moses should accept.
The people should bring gold.
They should bring silver.
They should bring bronze.
They should bring blue yarn.
They should bring purple yarn.
They should bring scarlet yarn.
They should bring fine linen.
They should bring goat hair.
They should bring ram skins dyed red.
They should bring fine leather.
They should bring acacia wood.
They should bring olive oil for the light.
They should bring spices for the anointing oil.
They should bring spices for the fragrant incense.
They should bring onyx stones.
They should bring gemstones to be set in the ephod and the breastpiece.
passages.original: וְזֹאת֙ הַתְּרוּמָ֔ה אֲשֶׁ֥ר תִּקְח֖וּ מֵאִתָּ֑ם זָהָ֥ב וָכֶ֖סֶף וּנְחֹֽשֶׁת׃ וּתְכֵ֧לֶת וְאַרְגָּמָ֛ן וְתוֹלַ֥עַת שָׁנִ֖י וְשֵׁ֥שׁ וְעִזִּֽים׃ וְעֹרֹ֨ת אֵילִ֧ם מְאָדָּמִ֛ים וְעֹרֹ֥ת תְּחָשִׁ֖ים וַעֲצֵ֥י שִׁטִּֽים׃ שֶׁ֖מֶן לַמָּאֹ֑ר בְּשָׂמִים֙ לְשֶׁ֣מֶן הַמִּשְׁחָ֔ה וְלִקְטֹ֖רֶת הַסַּמִּֽים׃ אַבְנֵי־ שֹׁ֕הַם וְאַבְנֵ֖י מִלֻּאִ֑ים לָאֵפֹ֖ד וְלַחֹֽשֶׁן׃

passages.text: And they are to make a sanctuary for Me, so that I may dwell among them.
passages.sermon:
God spoke to Moses.
God told Moses to instruct the Israelites.
The Israelites must build a sanctuary for God.
God will dwell among the Israelites in this sanctuary.
passages.original: וְעָ֥שׂוּ לִ֖י מִקְדָּ֑שׁ וְשָׁכַנְתִּ֖י בְּתוֹכָֽם׃

passages.text: You must make the tabernacle and design all its furnishings according to the pattern I show you.
passages.sermon:
God spoke to Moses.
God showed Moses the pattern for the tabernacle.
God also showed Moses the pattern for all the tabernacle’s furnishings.
God commanded the people to follow these patterns exactly.
They must build the tabernacle as God showed Moses.
They must make all the furnishings as God showed Moses.
passages.original: כְּכֹ֗ל אֲשֶׁ֤ר אֲנִי֙ מַרְאֶ֣ה אוֹתְךָ֔ אֵ֚ת תַּבְנִ֣ית הַמִּשְׁכָּ֔ן וְאֵ֖ת תַּבְנִ֣ית כָּל־ כֵּלָ֑יו וְכֵ֖ן תַּעֲשֽׂוּ׃ס

passages.text: And they are to construct an ark of acacia wood, two and a half cubits long, a cubit and a half wide, and a cubit and a half high.
passages.sermon:
God commanded the Israelites to build an ark.
They must use acacia wood.
The ark must be two and a half cubits long.
The ark must be one and a half cubits wide.
The ark must be one and a half cubits high.
passages.original: וְעָשׂ֥וּ אֲר֖וֹן עֲצֵ֣י שִׁטִּ֑ים אַמָּתַ֨יִם וָחֵ֜צִי אָרְכּ֗וֹ וְאַמָּ֤ה וָחֵ֙צִי֙ רָחְבּ֔וֹ וְאַמָּ֥ה וָחֵ֖צִי קֹמָתֽוֹ׃

passages.text: Overlay it with pure gold both inside and out, and make a gold molding around it.
passages.sermon:
God commanded Moses to build the ark.
The ark must be covered with pure gold.
Cover the ark with gold on the inside.
Cover the ark with gold on the outside.
Make a gold molding.
Place the gold molding around the ark.
passages.original: וְצִפִּיתָ֤ אֹתוֹ֙ זָהָ֣ב טָה֔וֹר מִבַּ֥יִת וּמִח֖וּץ תְּצַפֶּ֑נּוּ וְעָשִׂ֧יתָ עָלָ֛יו זֵ֥ר זָהָ֖ב סָבִֽיב׃

passages.text: Cast four gold rings for it and fasten them to its four feet, two rings on one side and two on the other.
passages.sermon:
The ark is a sacred box.
The ark is made of acacia wood.
Cast four gold rings for the ark.
Attach the rings to the four feet of the ark.
Put two rings on one side of the ark.
Put two rings on the other side of the ark.
passages.original: וְיָצַ֣קְתָּ לּ֗וֹ אַרְבַּע֙ טַבְּעֹ֣ת זָהָ֔ב וְנָ֣תַתָּ֔ה עַ֖ל אַרְבַּ֣ע פַּעֲמֹתָ֑יו וּשְׁתֵּ֣י טַבָּעֹ֗ת עַל־ צַלְעוֹ֙ הָֽאֶחָ֔ת וּשְׁתֵּי֙ טַבָּעֹ֔ת עַל־ צַלְע֖וֹ הַשֵּׁנִֽית׃

passages.text: And make poles of acacia wood and overlay them with gold.
passages.sermon:
God commanded Moses to build the ark.
God told Moses to make poles.
The poles must be made from acacia wood.
Moses must cover the poles with gold.
passages.original: וְעָשִׂ֥יתָ בַדֵּ֖י עֲצֵ֣י שִׁטִּ֑ים וְצִפִּיתָ֥ אֹתָ֖ם זָהָֽב׃

passages.text: Insert the poles into the rings on the sides of the ark, in order to carry it.
passages.sermon:
God commanded Moses to build the ark.
The ark had rings on its sides.
Moses must take the poles.
He must put the poles into the rings.
The poles go on the sides of the ark.
People will use the poles to carry the ark.
passages.original: וְהֵֽבֵאתָ֤ אֶת־ הַבַּדִּים֙ בַּטַּבָּעֹ֔ת עַ֖ל צַלְעֹ֣ת הָאָרֹ֑ן לָשֵׂ֥את אֶת־ הָאָרֹ֖ן בָּהֶֽם׃

passages.text: The poles are to remain in the rings of the ark; they must not be removed.
passages.sermon:
The ark is a sacred container.
The ark has rings on its sides.
Poles are placed in the rings of the ark.
The poles must stay in the rings.
No one may remove the poles from the rings.
passages.original: בְּטַבְּעֹת֙ הָאָרֹ֔ן יִהְי֖וּ הַבַּדִּ֑ים לֹ֥א יָסֻ֖רוּ מִמֶּֽנּוּ׃

passages.text: And place inside the ark the Testimony, which I will give you.
passages.sermon:
God spoke to Moses.
God commanded Moses to place the Testimony inside the ark.
The Testimony is what God will give to Moses.
Moses must put the Testimony into the ark.
passages.original: וְנָתַתָּ֖ אֶל־ הָאָרֹ֑ן אֵ֚ת הָעֵדֻ֔ת אֲשֶׁ֥ר אֶתֵּ֖ן אֵלֶֽיךָ׃

passages.text: And you are to construct a mercy seat of pure gold, two and a half cubits long and a cubit and a half wide.
passages.sermon:
God spoke to Moses.
God gave Moses instructions for the ark of the covenant.
God commanded Moses to make a mercy seat.
The mercy seat must be made of pure gold.
The mercy seat must be two and a half cubits long.
The mercy seat must be one and a half cubits wide.
passages.original: וְעָשִׂ֥יתָ כַפֹּ֖רֶת זָהָ֣ב טָה֑וֹר אַמָּתַ֤יִם וָחֵ֙צִי֙ אָרְכָּ֔הּ וְאַמָּ֥ה וָחֵ֖צִי רָחְבָּֽהּ׃

passages.text: Make two cherubim of hammered gold at the ends of the mercy seat, one cherub on one end and one on the other, all made from one piece of gold.
passages.sermon:
God gave Moses instructions for the ark of the covenant.
God told Moses to make two cherubim.
The cherubim must be made of pure gold.
Hammer the gold to form the cherubim.
Place the cherubim at the two ends of the mercy seat.
Make one cherub at one end.
Make the other cherub at the other end.
Form the cherubim from the same piece of gold as the mercy seat.
Put the cherubim on the two ends of the mercy seat.
passages.original: וְעָשִׂ֛יתָ שְׁנַ֥יִם כְּרֻבִ֖ים זָהָ֑ב מִקְשָׁה֙ תַּעֲשֶׂ֣ה אֹתָ֔ם מִשְּׁנֵ֖י קְצ֥וֹת הַכַּפֹּֽרֶת׃ וַ֠עֲשֵׂה כְּר֨וּב אֶחָ֤ד מִקָּצָה֙ מִזֶּ֔ה וּכְרוּב־ אֶחָ֥ד מִקָּצָ֖ה מִזֶּ֑ה מִן־ הַכַּפֹּ֛רֶת תַּעֲשׂ֥וּ אֶת־ הַכְּרֻבִ֖ים עַל־ שְׁנֵ֥י קְצוֹתָֽיו׃

passages.text: And the cherubim are to have wings that spread upward, overshadowing the mercy seat. The cherubim are to face each other, looking toward the mercy seat.
passages.sermon:
Cherubim are special heavenly beings.
God commanded that you make two cherubim.
Each cherub must have wings.
Their wings must spread upward.
Their wings must cover the mercy seat.
Each cherub must face the other cherub.
Both cherubim must look toward the mercy seat.
passages.original: וְהָי֣וּ הַכְּרֻבִים֩ פֹּרְשֵׂ֨י כְנָפַ֜יִם לְמַ֗עְלָה סֹכְכִ֤ים בְּכַנְפֵיהֶם֙ עַל־ הַכַּפֹּ֔רֶת וּפְנֵיהֶ֖ם אִ֣ישׁ אֶל־ אָחִ֑יו אֶל־ הַכַּפֹּ֔רֶת יִהְי֖וּ פְּנֵ֥י הַכְּרֻבִֽים׃

passages.text: Set the mercy seat atop the ark, and put the Testimony that I will give you into the ark.
passages.sermon:
God spoke to Moses.
God gave Moses instructions for the ark.
Place the mercy seat on top of the ark.
Take the Testimony that I will give you.
Put the Testimony inside the ark.
passages.original: וְנָתַתָּ֧ אֶת־ הַכַּפֹּ֛רֶת עַל־ הָאָרֹ֖ן מִלְמָ֑עְלָה וְאֶל־ הָ֣אָרֹ֔ן תִּתֵּן֙ אֶת־ הָ֣עֵדֻ֔ת אֲשֶׁ֥ר אֶתֵּ֖ן אֵלֶֽיךָ׃

passages.text: And I will meet with you there above the mercy seat, between the two cherubim that are over the ark of the Testimony; I will speak with you about all that I command you regarding the Israelites.
passages.sermon:
God will meet with Moses there.
God will meet above the mercy seat.
The mercy seat is between the two cherubim.
The two cherubim are over the ark of the Testimony.
God will speak with Moses from there.
God will tell Moses everything He commands about the Israelites.
passages.original: וְנוֹעַדְתִּ֣י לְךָ֮ שָׁם֒ וְדִבַּרְתִּ֨י אִתְּךָ֜ מֵעַ֣ל הַכַּפֹּ֗רֶת מִבֵּין֙ שְׁנֵ֣י הַכְּרֻבִ֔ים אֲשֶׁ֖ר עַל־ אֲרֹ֣ן הָעֵדֻ֑ת אֵ֣ת כָּל־ אֲשֶׁ֧ר אֲצַוֶּ֛ה אוֹתְךָ֖ אֶל־ בְּנֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃פ

passages.text: You are also to make a table of acacia wood two cubits long, a cubit wide, and a cubit and a half high.
passages.sermon:
God spoke to Moses.
God gave Moses instructions for the tabernacle.
God told Moses to make a table.
Make the table from acacia wood.
Make the table two cubits long.
Make the table one cubit wide.
Make the table one and a half cubits high.
passages.original: וְעָשִׂ֥יתָ שֻׁלְחָ֖ן עֲצֵ֣י שִׁטִּ֑ים אַמָּתַ֤יִם אָרְכּוֹ֙ וְאַמָּ֣ה רָחְבּ֔וֹ וְאַמָּ֥ה וָחֵ֖צִי קֹמָתֽוֹ׃

passages.text: Overlay it with pure gold and make a gold molding around it.
passages.sermon: God commanded Moses to make a table for the Tabernacle.\r\nMoses must cover the table with pure gold.\r\nMoses must make a gold molding around the table.
passages.original: וְצִפִּיתָ֥ אֹת֖וֹ זָהָ֣ב טָה֑וֹר וְעָשִׂ֥יתָ לּ֛וֹ זֵ֥ר זָהָ֖ב סָבִֽיב׃

passages.text: And make a rim around it a handbreadth wide and put a gold molding on the rim.
passages.sermon:
God commanded Moses to make a table for the Tabernacle.
The table must have a rim around it.
The rim must be a handbreadth wide.
Moses must make a gold molding for the rim.
The gold molding must go all around the rim.
passages.original: וְעָשִׂ֨יתָ לּ֥וֹ מִסְגֶּ֛רֶת טֹ֖פַח סָבִ֑יב וְעָשִׂ֧יתָ זֵר־ זָהָ֛ב לְמִסְגַּרְתּ֖וֹ סָבִֽיב׃

passages.text: Make four gold rings for the table and fasten them to the four corners at its four legs.
passages.sermon:
God gave Moses instructions for building the table for the Tabernacle.
The table must have four rings.
Make the rings out of gold.
Attach the rings to the table.
Place one ring on each of the four corners.
Each corner is at the foot of a leg of the table.
passages.original: וְעָשִׂ֣יתָ לּ֔וֹ אַרְבַּ֖ע טַבְּעֹ֣ת זָהָ֑ב וְנָתַתָּ֙ אֶת־ הַטַּבָּעֹ֔ת עַ֚ל אַרְבַּ֣ע הַפֵּאֹ֔ת אֲשֶׁ֖ר לְאַרְבַּ֥ע רַגְלָֽיו׃

passages.text: The rings are to be close to the rim, to serve as holders for the poles used to carry the table.
passages.sermon:
God commanded Moses to build a table for the Tabernacle.
The table must have a rim around it.
Place gold rings near the rim of the table.
These rings must be close to the rim.
The rings will hold the poles.
The poles are used to carry the table.
passages.original: לְעֻמַּת֙ הַמִּסְגֶּ֔רֶת תִּהְיֶ֖יןָ הַטַּבָּעֹ֑ת לְבָתִּ֣ים לְבַדִּ֔ים לָשֵׂ֖את אֶת־ הַשֻּׁלְחָֽן׃

passages.text: Make the poles of acacia wood and overlay them with gold, so that the table may be carried with them.
passages.sermon:
God commanded Moses to make poles for the table.
Make the poles from acacia wood.
Cover the poles with gold.
Use these poles to carry the table.
passages.original: וְעָשִׂ֤יתָ אֶת־ הַבַּדִּים֙ עֲצֵ֣י שִׁטִּ֔ים וְצִפִּיתָ֥ אֹתָ֖ם זָהָ֑ב וְנִשָּׂא־ בָ֖ם אֶת־ הַשֻּׁלְחָֽן׃

passages.text: You are also to make the plates and dishes, as well as the pitchers and bowls for pouring drink offerings. Make them out of pure gold.
passages.sermon:
God gave instructions for the tabernacle.
He commanded Moses to make special items for the table.
Make plates.
Make dishes.
Make pitchers.
Make bowls.
Use these for pouring drink offerings.
Make all these items from pure gold.
passages.original: וְעָשִׂ֨יתָ קְּעָרֹתָ֜יו וְכַפֹּתָ֗יו וּקְשׂוֹתָיו֙ וּמְנַקִּיֹּתָ֔יו אֲשֶׁ֥ר יֻסַּ֖ךְ בָּהֵ֑ן זָהָ֥ב טָה֖וֹר תַּעֲשֶׂ֥ה אֹתָֽם׃

passages.text: And place the Bread of the Presence on the table before Me at all times.
passages.sermon:
God commanded Moses.
God told Moses to place bread on the table.
This bread is called the Bread of the Presence.
The table stands before God.
The Bread of the Presence must always remain on the table.
passages.original: וְנָתַתָּ֧ עַֽל־ הַשֻּׁלְחָ֛ן לֶ֥חֶם פָּנִ֖ים לְפָנַ֥י תָּמִֽיד׃פ

passages.text: Then you are to make a lampstand of pure, hammered gold. It shall be made of one piece, including its base and shaft, its cups, and its buds and petals.
passages.sermon:
God commanded Moses to make a lampstand.
The lampstand must be made of pure gold.
The gold must be hammered.
The lampstand must be made from one piece of gold.
The lampstand must include its base.
The lampstand must include its shaft.
The lampstand must include its cups.
The lampstand must include its buds.
The lampstand must include its petals.
All these parts must come from the same piece of gold.
passages.original: וְעָשִׂ֥יתָ מְנֹרַ֖ת זָהָ֣ב טָה֑וֹר מִקְשָׁ֞ה תֵּעָשֶׂ֤ה הַמְּנוֹרָה֙ יְרֵכָ֣הּ וְקָנָ֔הּ גְּבִיעֶ֛יהָ כַּפְתֹּרֶ֥יהָ וּפְרָחֶ֖יהָ מִמֶּ֥נָּה יִהְיֽוּ׃

passages.text: Six branches are to extend from the sides of the lampstand—three on one side and three on the other.
passages.sermon:
God commanded Moses to make a lampstand.
The lampstand must have branches.
Six branches must extend from the sides of the lampstand.
Three branches must come out from one side.
Three branches must come out from the other side.
passages.original: וְשִׁשָּׁ֣ה קָנִ֔ים יֹצְאִ֖ים מִצִּדֶּ֑יהָ שְׁלֹשָׁ֣ה׀ קְנֵ֣י מְנֹרָ֗ה מִצִּדָּהּ֙ הָאֶחָ֔ד וּשְׁלֹשָׁה֙ קְנֵ֣י מְנֹרָ֔ה מִצִּדָּ֖הּ הַשֵּׁנִֽי׃

passages.text: There are to be three cups shaped like almond blossoms on the first branch, each with buds and petals, three on the next branch, and the same for all six branches that extend from the lampstand.
passages.sermon:
God commanded Moses to make a lampstand for the Tabernacle.
The lampstand must have six branches.
Each branch must have three cups.
Each cup must look like an almond blossom.
Each cup must have a bud and a petal.
Every branch must be the same.
All six branches that come out from the lampstand must have these cups, buds, and petals.
passages.original: שְׁלֹשָׁ֣ה גְ֠בִעִים מְֽשֻׁקָּדִ֞ים בַּקָּנֶ֣ה הָאֶחָד֮ כַּפְתֹּ֣ר וָפֶרַח֒ וּשְׁלֹשָׁ֣ה גְבִעִ֗ים מְשֻׁקָּדִ֛ים בַּקָּנֶ֥ה הָאֶחָ֖ד כַּפְתֹּ֣ר וָפָ֑רַח כֵּ֚ן לְשֵׁ֣שֶׁת הַקָּנִ֔ים הַיֹּצְאִ֖ים מִן־ הַמְּנֹרָֽה׃

passages.text: And on the lampstand there shall be four cups shaped like almond blossoms with buds and petals.
passages.sermon:
The lampstand is a special object made for the Tabernacle.
The lampstand is made of pure gold.
The lampstand has branches and decorations.
On the lampstand, there are four cups.
Each cup is shaped like an almond blossom.
Each cup has buds.
Each cup has petals.
passages.original: וּבַמְּנֹרָ֖ה אַרְבָּעָ֣ה גְבִעִ֑ים מְשֻׁקָּדִ֔ים כַּפְתֹּרֶ֖יהָ וּפְרָחֶֽיהָ׃

passages.text: For the six branches that extend from the lampstand, a bud must be under the first pair of branches, a bud under the second pair, and a bud under the third pair.
passages.sermon:
The lampstand has six branches.
Each branch extends from the lampstand.
There are three pairs of branches.
A bud must be under the first pair of branches.
A bud must be under the second pair of branches.
A bud must be under the third pair of branches.
passages.original: וְכַפְתֹּ֡ר תַּחַת֩ שְׁנֵ֨י הַקָּנִ֜ים מִמֶּ֗נָּה וְכַפְתֹּר֙ תַּ֣חַת שְׁנֵ֤י הַקָּנִים֙ מִמֶּ֔נָּה וְכַפְתֹּ֕ר תַּחַת־ שְׁנֵ֥י הַקָּנִ֖ים מִמֶּ֑נָּה לְשֵׁ֙שֶׁת֙ הַקָּנִ֔ים הַיֹּצְאִ֖ים מִן־ הַמְּנֹרָֽה׃

passages.text: The buds and branches are to be all of one piece with the lampstand, hammered out of pure gold.
passages.sermon:
The lampstand is made of pure gold.
The lampstand has buds and branches.
The buds and branches are not separate parts.
The buds and branches are one piece with the lampstand.
The entire lampstand is hammered from a single piece of pure gold.
passages.original: כַּפְתֹּרֵיהֶ֥ם וּקְנֹתָ֖ם מִמֶּ֣נָּה יִהְי֑וּ כֻּלָּ֛הּ מִקְשָׁ֥ה אַחַ֖ת זָהָ֥ב טָהֽוֹר׃

passages.text: Make seven lamps and set them up on the lampstand so that they illuminate the area in front of it.
passages.sermon:
God commanded Moses to make a lampstand.
The lampstand must have seven lamps.
Place the seven lamps on the lampstand.
Set up the lamps so they shine light in front of the lampstand.
passages.original: וְעָשִׂ֥יתָ אֶת־ נֵרֹתֶ֖יהָ שִׁבְעָ֑ה וְהֶֽעֱלָה֙ אֶת־ נֵ֣רֹתֶ֔יהָ וְהֵאִ֖יר עַל־ עֵ֥בֶר פָּנֶֽיהָ׃

passages.text: The wick trimmers and their trays must be of pure gold.
passages.sermon:
God gave instructions for the lampstand in the tabernacle.
The lampstand had wick trimmers.
The lampstand had trays.
The wick trimmers must be made of pure gold.
The trays must be made of pure gold.
passages.original: וּמַלְקָחֶ֥יהָ וּמַחְתֹּתֶ֖יהָ זָהָ֥ב טָהֽוֹר׃

passages.text: The lampstand and all these utensils shall be made from a talent of pure gold.
passages.sermon:
God commanded Moses to make a lampstand.
God also commanded Moses to make all the utensils for the lampstand.
Moses must use pure gold for the lampstand and all its utensils.
Moses must use one talent of pure gold for everything.
passages.original: כִּכָּ֛ר זָהָ֥ב טָה֖וֹר יַעֲשֶׂ֣ה אֹתָ֑הּ אֵ֥ת כָּל־ הַכֵּלִ֖ים הָאֵֽלֶּה׃

passages.text: See to it that you make everything according to the pattern shown you on the mountain.
passages.sermon:
God spoke to Moses on the mountain.
God showed Moses a pattern for the tabernacle and its utensils.
God commanded Moses to make everything by this pattern.
Moses must follow exactly what God showed him on the mountain.
passages.original: וּרְאֵ֖ה וַעֲשֵׂ֑ה בְּתַ֨בְנִיתָ֔ם אֲשֶׁר־ אַתָּ֥ה מָרְאֶ֖ה בָּהָֽר׃ס
